Landing.heroSubtitle: Evaluate recurring bills with transparent weighted scoring, detect hidden subscriptions, and receive deterministic decision safeguards—100% under your control.
Landing.evaluatorSubtitle: Rate any recurring service from 1 to 5 to compute an audit-proof 0–100 score.
Landing.feature1Desc: No AI hallucinations for math. Pure TypeScript scoring ensures 100% repeatable, explainable results.
Landing.feature2Desc: Extract recurring candidate transactions from bank CSVs and text-based PDFs with Papa Parse & PDF.js.
Landing.feature3Desc: Balance usage, necessity, affordability, uniqueness, and satisfaction before deciding to keep or cancel.
Landing.feature4Desc: Zero direct banking logins required. PostgreSQL Row Level Security (RLS) protects user records.
